role: Local planning authority tree officer determining applications for works to protected trees
setting: A district council's arboricultural team receives applications to fell, reduce or prune trees covered by tree preservation orders. The tree officer opens one application record at a time, compares the applicant's tree schedule with the order register entry and the submitted arboricultural report, checks site constraints and the property's enforcement history, and decides on the evidence, the decision to issue, the inspection priority and the extent of works proposed.

evidence_supports_works.instructions: Current arboricultural evidence supports the full extent of works applied for.

criteria.true: Recent report recommends works at least this extensive
criteria.false: Report absent, stale, or recommends lighter works

decision.instructions: What decision should be issued on this application?

criteria.refuse: Works unjustified or harmful to amenity; consent withheld entirely
criteria.request_info: Decision held pending one missing or out-of-date item
criteria.grant_conditional: Works acceptable only if scaled back or made subject to conditions
criteria.grant_as_applied: Works justified as submitted; consent issued without any changes

inspection_priority.instructions: How quickly should an officer site inspection be scheduled?

criteria.standard_queue: No hazard reported; determination deadline over four weeks away
criteria.schedule_soon: No hazard reported; determination deadline two to four weeks away
criteria.expedite: Deadline under two weeks, or hazard already made safe
criteria.emergency_visit: Highway or imminent-failure hazard reported with no interim safety measures

affected_scope.instructions: How many people or units does this issue directly affect?
criteria: Affects one person or unit only
Affects two to five people or units
Affects six to twenty people or units
Affects more than twenty people or units

works_extent.instructions: What is the greatest extent of works proposed on any tree?
criteria: Deadwood removal, cleaning or crown lift only

factors.name: order_coverage
factors.description: Whether the trees listed in the application all appear in the order register entry; some listed trees may be absent or only covered by an area designation

factors.name: schedule_report_discrepancy
factors.description: Mismatch between the applicant's tree schedule and the arboricultural report for the same tree: none, stem diameter differs slightly, species differs, or report recommends lighter works than applied for

factors.name: condition_grade
factors.description: Arboricultural condition grade of the principal tree as recorded in the report

factors.name: max_reduction_pct
factors.description: Largest crown reduction proposed on any tree in the schedule; 0 means minor pruning only, 100 means felling; values cluster near 20 and 30 for boundary cases

factors.name: damage_claim
factors.description: Applicant cites subsidence or structural damage to a building attributed to the tree

factors.name: engineer_evidence
factors.description: Structural engineer's monitoring and root identification confirming tree involvement; present for roughly half of damage claims, absent otherwise

factors.name: bat_roost_potential
factors.description: Report or constraints layer flags features with potential to support roosting bats

factors.name: ecology_survey_clear
factors.description: A dated emergence survey found no roost, lowering concern about the bat flag

factors.name: prior_contraventions
factors.description: Number of recorded unauthorised works to protected trees at the property

factors.name: contravention_resolved
factors.description: Replacement planting required after a past contravention has been verified as completed

factors.name: report_age_months
factors.description: Months between the arboricultural survey date and the application received date; over 12 counts as stale

factors.name: days_to_deadline
factors.description: Days between today's review date and the statutory determination date

factors.name: reported_hazard
factors.description: Hazard condition noted in the report or site constraints

factors.name: interim_measures
factors.description: Cordon, propping or emergency limb removal already in place, making a reported hazard safe

sections.name: application
sections.description: Reference, received date, determination date, review date, applicant type, cited grounds codes

sections.name: tree_schedule
sections.description: List of trees applied for: applicant tree id, species, dbh_cm, works code, reduction_pct

sections.name: order_register
sections.description: Order reference, confirmed flag, designation type, list of protected tree ids with species and dbh_cm

sections.name: arb_report
sections.description: Survey date, per-tree condition grade, dbh_cm, recommended works and reduction_pct, hazard code, bat features flag

sections.name: site_constraints
sections.description: Conservation area flag, highway adjacency, ecology survey record, interim measures, engineer monitoring record

sections.name: case_history
sections.description: Prior applications count, contraventions list with dates and replanting verification status

rendering_notes: order_coverage: compare tree_schedule ids and species with order_register.trees; one_tree_absent shows a schedule id missing from the register list; area_designation_only shows designation 'area' with an empty trees list; order_ref_wrong shows application.order_ref differing from order_register.order_ref by a digit. schedule_report_discrepancy: same tree id carries different dbh_cm (under 10%), species, or a lower reduction_pct or lighter works code in arb_report than in tree_schedule; never flagged. condition_grade appears only in arb_report.trees[].condition. max_reduction_pct appears as tree_schedule[].reduction_pct, with works code 'fell' for 100 and 'deadwood'/'lift' for 0. damage_claim appears as grounds code 'SUBS' in application.grounds; engineer_evidence as site_constraints.engineer_monitoring object with months_monitored and roots_identified, or null. bat_roost_potential as arb_report.bat_features true; ecology_survey_clear as site_constraints.ecology_survey with date and roost_found false, or null. prior_contraventions as case_history.contraventions list; contravention_resolved as replant_verified true/false per item. report_age_months is derived from arb_report.survey_date versus application.received; days_to_deadline from application.review_date versus application.determination_due. reported_hazard as arb_report hazard code plus site_constraints.highway_adjacent; interim_measures as site_constraints.interim_measures list (cordon, prop) or empty. Decoys: order_register.confirmed false (a provisional order still protects), conservation_area flag (irrelevant when the order applies), prior_applications count (approved applications are not contraventions), minor_deadwood hazard code, small dbh differences. No record may contain a recommendation, priority, risk rating, justified flag or decision field; the report gives only measurements, grades and recommended works.
